headline: Blockbuster: Tommy C Ships Michael Penix Jr. to Tripp for Kenneth Mitchell
blurb: League insiders are split on whether this is genius or a cry for help. Tripp, sitting at 4-1, reportedly "already feels like a champion."

headline: Josh Cycles Through Kickers and Defenses Like a Man Possessed
blurb: Coyote’s Cocky Team, 1-4, has made more waiver moves this week than some owners make all season. Sources say the 49ers DEF "never stood a chance."
